request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2, including a part-time maintainer over 12 months and Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time Dolos maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement and 15,750 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient chain-data access without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.
The maintainer work will cover essential maintenance, community support, and upgrades for AI-driven development workflows.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a year of Dolos maintenance through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts, citing open-source project metrics, prior funding history, Hydra voting approval, NCL compliance, and oversight/disbursement controls.
